genre: story/hustle montage over a voiceover spine
identity: A narration (the creator's own, or iconic movie audio) drives a fast rotation of 1-2 second b-roll clips that ILLUSTRATE each phrase. Captions are one word or one short phrase at a time, placed at the spoken instant. The montage look splits by skin from raw-authentic to art-directed, but the mechanics are constant: speech phrase -> matching clip -> caption, 5-7 cuts per 10s, muted grade, CTA outro.

movie-audio-bw.notes: Wolf of Wall Street audio; FULL monochrome; single-word center captions; 72 flash frames (whips)

lifestyle-money.notes: creator narration; giant airbrushed money words ($500,000, TOP 1%); Stripe-style revenue-proof cards; scattered small-caps captions

raw-startup-vlog.notes: handheld phone clips, plain white bottom-third phrase captions, zero decoration — authenticity IS the style

designed-travel.notes: poster-grade full-frame type cards (red/black), animated flight-path maps, social-UI comment props between b-roll

rules.clip_selection: each clip literally or thematically matches the phrase being spoken ('travel the world' -> beach; 'coding' -> screen); a clip never outstays its phrase
rules.captions: ONE word or short phrase at a time, appearing at its spoken instant; position varies by skin (center / bottom-third / scattered)
rules.display_moments: 2-5 times per video a KEY phrase gets a full-frame or oversized display treatment (money number, poster card, giant NO)
rules.proof_props: money/social skins insert UI evidence (revenue cards, comment threads, profile mockups) timed to the claims
rules.grade: muted always; skins choose full-monochrome, teal-warm lifestyle, or platform-compressed raw
rules.cta: final 10-15%: direct-address clip or card + comment-keyword/follow instruction + logo outro

rubric.phrase_clip_match: every caption phrase's clip must depict or metaphorize it

capability_notes: Selection needs the caption-phrase -> footage-moment match, which is exactly what a sighted index provides (shot captions + transcript). Display money-words and poster cards = add_text templates; revenue-proof/comment props are a graphics-pack gap (same gap as talking-head-promo's ui_mockups).
